# Healing Hands Physical Therapy Associates LLC

> Personalized, evidence-based physical therapy care for Livonia, Novi, Farmington and all of Wayne & Oakland County.

Healing Hands Physical Therapy Associates LLC provides personalized, evidence-based physical therapy care. With over 70 years of combined clinical experience, our board-certified, fellowship-trained orthopedic physical therapists offer an evidence-based biopsychosocial approach that consistently delivers faster, superior functional outcomes.

## Our Services

### Recover Rebuild Return.
Regain movement, strength, and confidence after injury or surgery with care designed just for you. We treat a wide range of conditions—from sprains and tendon issues to joint replacements and neurological conditions—for kids, adults, and seniors alike. We incorporate advanced tools such as musculoskeletal (MSK) ultrasound, surface EMG biofeedback, and Blood Flow Restriction (BFR) training.

### Neck and Back Care
Advanced care for neck and back pain designed to help you move comfortably and confidently again. Our personalized treatment plans combine hands-on therapy, targeted exercises, and education to address the root cause of pain and support long-term relief.

### Male Pelvic Health Care
Discreet, specialized physical therapy for men experiencing pelvic pain or bladder control concerns. Our care combines hands-on manual therapy, internal pelvic floor trigger point management, and dry needling with advanced tools such as biofeedback, musculoskeletal ultrasound, and EMG.

### Vestibular Rehab
Targeted therapy for BPPV, vestibular neuritis, and balance disorders. By integrating the latest neuro-scientific research, we use evidence-based maneuvers and habituation exercises tailored to specific symptoms to stop dizziness, vertigo, and imbalance.

### Cervicogenic Headaches
We combine cutting-edge manual therapy research with a personalized approach to treat the root cause of headaches originating from the cervical spine. We utilize advanced mobilization techniques, dry needling, targeted muscle re-education, posture restoration, and ergonomics.

### TMJ Disorders
Relieve jaw pain, tension, and clicking with specialized TMJ physical therapy designed to restore comfortable movement and function. Our comprehensive approach integrates hands-on manual therapy, intra-oral techniques, dry needling, targeted exercise, and posture correction.

### Wellness & Fitness (Exercise Smarter, Not Harder)
An individualized wellness program that includes education, movement assessment, and progressive exercise planning to optimize training load, minimize injury risk, and enhance long-term adherence.
